name: Lip-Sync Dance Short
summary: A vertical clip of one person who mimes a song or does a short dance in front of a phone, with a rotating record disc and a lyric line. It grew from the Musical.ly app in 2014 and moved to TikTok in 2016 and 2018.

philosophy.core_thesis: One person, one song hook and one move: the clip works when the body and the beat are the only content.
design_principles: Shoot at 1080 x 1920 px with one subject, centred, at 60% to 75% of the frame height.
Cut the clip to 15 s, with the loop point on a beat so the end meets the start.
Place a spinning record disc 48 px wide at the bottom right with a 4 s turn.
Set the lyric line in 44 px bold white caps with a 3 px black outline, at 70% of the frame height.
Add a pink-to-cyan accent bar of 6 px under the caption and keep it at 100% width.
Light the face with a ring light: a round catch-light of 20 px in each eye.
Flash a 4-frame colour pulse (#FE2C55 then #25F4EE) on each strong beat.
anti_patterns: Long text blocks over the dancer
Slow, quiet pacing with no beat
Horizontal logos in the top corners
Dark moody grading that hides the face
A tripod shot with no movement of the body

layout.grid_mechanics: A single full-bleed vertical frame; one safe zone of 960 x 1340 px; a right rail of 5 icons at 96 px pitch.
layout.whitespace_ratio: The subject takes 60% to 75% of the frame; text and icons take under 15%.
layout.alignment_rules: The subject sits centred; the caption sits centred; the icon rail aligns to the right edge with a 24 px margin.
layout.container_geometry: Round capture frame with 0 radius on the video; circular record disc and 48 px circle buttons.

font_pairings.note: A geometric sans in bold weights for lyric lines, with a neutral body face.
Wide caps for the lyric line.

hierarchy_rules: Use bold (700) for lyric lines and regular (400) for the username.
Set lyric lines at 44 px and the username at 28 px.
Show at most 2 lines of 22 characters in a caption.
Put a 3 px black outline around white text.

color.palette_structure: Near-black frame with white text, one hot pink and one cyan edge.
color.contrast_rules: White text on ink gives 18:1; text over video always has a 3 px outline.
color.surface_treatment: Flat colour for the UI; the video fills the ground.
color.light_and_shadow: Hard front light from a ring light; a split red and cyan edge glow on the subject at 2 px to 4 px offset.

materiality.surface_simulation: A phone screen: glossy video with flat UI overlays.
materiality.border_rules: No borders on video; 2 px white ring on the record disc.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur on the video; a 40% black gradient of 240 px at the bottom helps the caption.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Solid 28 px icons for like, comment, share and sound, with a count under each.
ornamentation_details.illustration: A spinning vinyl disc with a small cover picture; floating music notes.

motion.transition_physics: Loop of 15 s; zoom pulses of 105% on each strong beat; the record disc turns 360° in 4 s.
motion.hover_and_active: A tap on the heart scales it to 130% in 150 ms and fills it pink.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels the beat and wants to copy the move.

avoid_when: The audience needs a calm or formal tone.

modifiers.how: Drop the beat pulse and the colour edge; talk to the camera in a soft room.
Cut the clip to 6 or more shots and add speed ramps on the beat.
Split the frame 50/50 and put the second performer on the right.

pack.why: A filled, rounded icon family that matches the heart and share icons of a short-video rail.

ground.why: The ground is a dark frame with confetti-like colour flecks that echo the beat pulses of the dance clips.

tailwind.classes: rounded-full bg-[#FE2C55] px-6 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-150
